title: TrackAI audit event, version 1
description: One security_audit_events row as the audit read API (Task16c) returns it. Every field is required and no other field is allowed. The per-action details keys, allowed actor types and target id formats are in catalog.md (generated from apps/api/src/core/audit/catalog.ts). severity and catalog_version are derived from the catalog when the row is read; they are not stored.

action.description: A catalog action. v1 keeps today's names exactly, including their mixed separators.

actor_id.description: The Supabase subject for a person, the operator token for a CLI, the machine id for a machine, the service name for a service.

target_id.description: A row id, the tenant id, or a documented compound format, per the catalog entry's target id kind.

details.description: Exactly the catalog entry's keys; never raw customer content.

severity.description: Derived from the catalog, not stored.

catalog_version.description: AUDIT_CATALOG_VERSION when the row was read. Derived, not stored.
